title: ScipDocumentContribution
description: Mirror of the SCIP `Document` record (https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip), document-level metadata only. The two heavy `repeated` fields of `Document` -- `occurrences[]` and `symbols[]` -- are NOT inlined here; they are projected as their own first-class slots `itip:Index.ScipOccurrence` and `itip:Index.ScipSymbol` so they remain individually addressable, individually citable from `itip:CodeGraph.*` edges, and individually reducible. The `text` field is also not surfaced (the canonical source bytes live in git / `itip:Repository.FileNode`). identityKey: `relativePath`. Producer rule: exactly ONE producer per (panel, slot, relativePath); v1 producer is `ScipJavaKS`, future per-language indexers (`scip-typescript`, `scip-python`, ...) will share this slot scoped by language. Field-name convention: surfaced fields use SCIP proto3 canonical-JSON camelCase encoding; producers emitting snake_case MUST normalize before contribution. `additionalProperties: true` to absorb future SCIP `Document` fields without breaking validation.

relativePath.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the source file. Verbatim from SCIP `Document.relative_path`.

language.description: Source language as the SCIP indexer reports it. Verbatim from SCIP `Document.language` (e.g. 'java', 'kotlin', 'scala', 'typescript', 'python').

positionEncoding.description: Verbatim SCIP `Document.position_encoding` (e.g. 'UTF8CodeUnitOffsetFromLineStart', 'UTF16CodeUnitOffsetFromLineStart', 'UTF32CodeUnitOffsetFromLineStart'). REQUIRED for any consumer that interprets `Index.ScipOccurrence.occurrence.range` against source bytes; omit only when unknown.

scipIndexerVersion.description: Version string of the SCIP indexer that produced the record (e.g. scip-java, scip-typescript). Optional; useful for replay diagnostics.
